The surname '''Cauthon''' can refer to the following people:

*[[Matrim Cauthon]] - a young man from Emond's Field, ''[[ta'veren]]'', leader of the [[Band of the Red Hand]], husband of the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]] and thus [[The Prince of the Ravens]].
*[[Abell Cauthon]] - a horse trader in [[Emond's Field]], husband of Natti and father of Bodewhin, Eldrin and Matrim.
*[[Natti Cauthon]] - a woman from Emond's Field and part of the [[Women's Circle]] there, wife of Abell and mother of Bodewhin, Eldrin and Matrim.
*[[Bodewhin Cauthon]] - a girl from Emond's Field, nicknamed "Bode," a [[Novice]] in the [[Rebel Aes Sedai|Tower in exile]], sister of Eldrin and Matrim, and daughter of Abell and Natti.
*[[Eldrin Cauthon]] - a girl from Emond's Field, two years younger than [[Egwene al'Vere]], sister of Bodewhin and Matrim, daughter of Abell and Natti.
